messages.author: 07796542ebc292bb
messages.subject: group = floor_date()
parts:
Hi there folks.

I recently got a new pc and installed the latest versions of R and ggplot2, but some of my old dependable scripts are not working now.

Specifically, I seem to be having trouble using the 'group = floor_date(date, "1 week")' argument to bin date data into groups. 

I am wondering if it could be a bug in the latest ggplot2 version?  I am wondering if somebody who is familiar with this type of code could check it out for me.

Many thanks in advance,

Harry

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: group = floor_date()
parts:
Hi:

Load the scales package along with ggplot2.

> getAnywhere('floor_date')
A single object matching ‘floor_date’ was found
It was found in the following places
namespace:scales

Dennis

messages.author: 07796542ebc292bb
messages.subject: Re: group = floor_date()
parts:
Thanks Dennis,

I tried this idea, but it did not seem to be solving the issue. 

However, I found some notes on Github discussing floor_date in ggplot2 and lubridate. Loading lubridate seemed to help, but i needed to specify the time differently "week" instead of "1 week".  This seemed to solve the floor_date issue. 

I also seem to be having new issues on my scales_x_date,  it doesn't seem to like "%b" anymore - i suspect its a related problem.

h

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: group = floor_date()
parts:
The date scales have been moved to the scales package and are used
differently in 0.9.0 from what they were in previous versions. See
http://bit.ly/AhLHuV , particularly section 7.

Dennis
